units.source_text: 可是，与大都会相距八公里多的这个市镇，直至二三十年前才膨胀起来，

en.t: However, this town, located more than eight kilometers from the metropolis, did not begin to expand until twenty or thirty years ago,

units.source_text: 眼看着变成一片工厂地带，许多外地人都迁到这里来，狗当然也增加了。

en.t: and before long it had become an industrial district, many outsiders had moved in, and naturally the number of dogs increased as well.

units.source_text: 这种把狗当作死神的信仰和权威也都丧失了。

en.t: The belief and authority that treated dogs as gods of death were also lost.

units.source_text: 不过，死了人的人家，则依然默守着让狗殉葬的旧习。

en.t: Even so, households in which someone had died still quietly observed the old custom of burying a dog with the dead.

units.source_text: 有时候为了这种事，旧居民和新来者之间还发生过冲突。

en.t: At times, conflicts even broke out over such matters between longtime residents and newcomers.

units.source_text: 让倒霉的狗活下去，总之是件可怕的事，这是这个镇上的人们自古以来的想法。

en.t: In any case, letting an ill-fated dog live was a frightening thing; that was what the people of this town had believed since ancient times.

units.source_text: 总之参拜“狗坟”的人也是源源不断。

en.t: At any rate, people continued without end to visit and worship at the Dog Grave.
